findings.title: Approval positive inline examples contradict authority and omit grants
findings.required_fix: Seed reviewer_worker for intended assigned-reviewer positive cases. Use self (submitter) for the withdrawn success row or add a properly seeded scoped coordinator. Retain a separate reviewer-withdrawn denial. Apply consistently to focused handlers and full/mutation variants; refresh hashes/measurements.
findings.initial_evidence: reviewer_user,withdrawn expects Withdrawn although the actor is neither submitter nor coordinator and both require and Submission read policy exclude assigned reviewers for withdrawn state. The other three reviewer_user rows use document.location=test_site but do not seed reviewer_worker, required by can_work. pending_version transitively seeds reviewer_user/document/test_site, not reviewer_worker.
findings.correction_recheck: All 15 approval .can files seed reviewer_worker; positive withdrawn row now uses self, the document submitter. The JSON retains a separate assigned-reviewer withdrawn denial with no caption.

findings.title: Hiring positive examples omit employee grant fixture
findings.required_fix: Add seed=[test_worker] to positive hiring tables, preserving identical fixtures across all alternatives; include a separately specified revoked/inactive worker negative.
findings.initial_evidence: The recruiter table caller needs can_work(actor,candidate.parent.location); applicant references vacancy/test_site and self but not test_worker. Employees.can defines can_work through a currently active Employee record. An actor role grant alone cannot create that record.
findings.correction_recheck: All 15 ordinary .can files seed test_worker. The revoked worker negative specifies inactive test_worker with recruiter role retained and no alternate current Employee grant.

findings.title: Authority cases need read-route admission scope and explicit setup
findings.required_fix: Specify caller, membership, grants, location, readable reference and chosen route for every finite/denial case. Keep rule_failed as the authored false-require expectation only when guard execution is reached; settle exact protected read admission failure with the released route before claiming observed codes. Do not blindly substitute not_found.
findings.initial_evidence: The value cases lack actor/location/grant prerequisites. Denial expectations state exact rule_failed for hidden/revoked references but are not compiled route observations. DESIGN 314/369 keeps ordinary read=true bodies viewer-filtered; DESIGN 342 distinguishes mutation opaque-ID admission from read lookup. Current packages/state/src/invocation/invoke.ts invokeRead serves generated reads only, so it cannot certify the added user read scenarios.
findings.correction_recheck: Finite/authority cases now state chosen unqualified read route, caller, membership, fixture seed, location/work grants and reference assumptions. Security outcome is separated from authored gate/guard error and unverified canonical first error.

findings.title: Some diagnostic/mutation expectations have no corresponding raw fixture
findings.required_fix: Either add bounded raw negative/mutation inputs when this scope is required, or explicitly classify these cases as future contract vectors rather than completed comparison experiments. No observed compiler diagnostic follows from their prose.
findings.initial_evidence: Raw add-case and proposed-match omit-case files exist for three caption routes. Current-if omitted-branch sources, owner-case removal sources and catalog ImageRun.state addition inputs are absent. Duplicate/foreign/nullable/scope/effectful-subject/return vectors are prose proposed_input only.
findings.correction_recheck: Three caption routes have raw current/improved-if omitted-branch and owner-case removal sources alongside match sources. ImageRun catalog mutation is an unexecuted JSON input. Eight concrete proposed probes exist; effectful-subject instrumentation is explicitly future. Residual probe coverage limits recorded separately.

findings.title: No tokenizer evidence and incomplete packet-wide source-cost tally
findings.required_fix: Keep the current exact byte/whitespace table as a scoped proxy. If the value decision requires all authored source/token cost, add mutation-source tallies and a pinned named tokenizer/configuration with separate runtime/tooling/source costs; otherwise carry this as an explicit unclosed value gate.
findings.initial_evidence: All 12 listed bytes/whitespace counts reproduce exactly, including comments/examples and full baseline app source. Model/compiler token_count correctly says not measured. Counts cover the three principal variants per route, not all add/omit-case mutation files or a proposed strictness opt-in. Whitespace units are not token counts.
findings.correction_recheck: All 12 principal measurement rows refreshed and independently reproduced. packet-source-costs covers all 64 .can files with exact reproducible bytes/whitespace units, including originals, repeated full apps, mutations and probes. Tokens and runtime/tooling cost remain explicitly unmeasured.
